name: 3-colouring five fixed cycle-plus-triangles graphs
description: construct() -> five colourings (one colour in {0, 1, 2} per vertex), one per instance from cycle_plus_triangles(n, seed) for n = 30, 60, 90, 150, 300 with seeds 401..405 in the verifier: the Hamiltonian cycle 0-1-...-(n-1)-0 plus a random partition into triangles avoiding cycle edges. The score is the number of properly coloured instances (0..5). Maximize; every instance is 3-colourable by the Fleischner-Stiebitz theorem. The score counts fixed instances coloured properly; it measures a constructive colouring method for graphs whose colourability is known only through an algebraic proof.
